introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: IPEACE Professional Consulting is committed to protecting your privacy and personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our services.

personal.title: Personal Information
personal.content: We collect personal information that you voluntarily provide to us when using our services, including:
examples: Name and contact details (email, phone, address)

usage.title: Usage Information
usage.content: We automatically collect information about how you interact with our services, including:
examples: Pages visited and time spent on our website

howWeUseInformation.title: How We Use Your Information
howWeUseInformation.content: We use your information for various business purposes, including:
purposes: Providing and improving our consulting services
Communicating with you about your inquiries and requests
Sending you updates and marketing communications (with your consent)
Complying with legal and regulatory requirements
Analyzing usage patterns to enhance user experience

dataProtection.title: Data Protection
dataProtection.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction.

sharingOfInformation.title: Sharing of Information
sharingOfInformation.content: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share information in the following circumstances:
cases: With service providers who assist in delivering our services
When required by law or to protect our rights and property
In connection with a business transfer or merger
With your explicit consent for specific purposes

yourRights.title: Your Rights
yourRights.content: You have certain rights regarding your personal information, including:
rights: Right to access and receive a copy of your personal data
Right to correct or update inaccurate information
Right to request deletion of your personal data
Right to object to processing of your personal data
Right to data portability and transfer

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.content: We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to provide our services and comply with legal obligations. The retention period varies based on the type of information and purpose.

cookies.title: Cookies and Tracking Technologies
cookies.content: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience and analyze usage patterns. You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings.

thirdPartyLinks.title: Third-Party Links
thirdPartyLinks.content: Our services may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of these external sites. We encourage you to review their privacy policies.

childrenPrivacy.title: Children's Privacy
childrenPrivacy.content: Our services are not intended for individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

changesToPolicy.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
changesToPolicy.content: We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the 'Last Updated' date.
